Copied from the Glyx design kit (`glyx-design-kit/`, a sibling of this repo),
so the DevTools UI builds without it:

- `tokens.css` ← `spec/tokens.css`
- `glyx-symbol-dark.svg`, `glyx-symbol-light.svg` ← `svg/`
- `favicon.svg` ← `favicon/favicon.svg`

When the kit changes, copy them again. Don't edit them here.
